title: Exact quadratic relation orbits
objective: Implement authenticated quadratic-conjugation factor-base permutations and exact derived relation admission with deterministic capability fallback, mutation differentials, and benchmark

handoff.summary: Adds exact real/imaginary quadratic conjugation plans, SHA-authenticated factor-base permutations, exact element/ideal/row maps, mapped factored-witness admission through ExactRelationCollector, detached replay, deterministic fixed/incomplete/unsupported fallbacks, mutation differentials, and a representative orbit benchmark.
risks: Orbit admission is intentionally opt-in and skips conjugation-fixed rows; callers decide which admitted relations merit an orbit attempt.
Degree greater than two remains unavailable until the field layer exposes exact self-maps with element images and enough public evidence to map ideals and authenticate the map identity.
next_steps: Integrate the commit without automatic orbit expansion in the engine; call collector.admit_automorphism_orbit only when the plan reports available and useful.
Run the lane-mandatory pnpm test:native receipt in central integration, then move this contract to review.
If generic automorphisms are later added, extend the same authenticated plan protocol rather than interpreting abstract Galois permutations.
